name: 任务启动
description: 从当前项目的 GitHub issue 用可编辑的提示词启动 Enso 会话：列出 origin 的 issue，套用提示词模板，再新建会话并聚焦。可选在干净的工作区创建并切换分支。不创建 worktree，也不替代 GitHub 插件。

configuration.title: Personal Access Token（可选）
configuration.description: 不想用设备码登录时填写。读取 issue 即可；私有仓库需要对应仓库的访问权限

agentTools.name: task_list
agentTools.description: List GitHub issues for a repository (defaults to the current project's origin). Pull requests are omitted. Returns number, title, state, author, labels, assignees, suggestedBranch, and url. Does not start a session.

repo.description: owner/name; omit to use the current project's GitHub origin

query.description: Case-insensitive filter on title, number, author, labels, and assignees

agentTools.name: task_preview
agentTools.description: Render the saved prompt template for one GitHub issue and report whether creating a branch in the current checkout would be blocked by uncommitted changes. Does not create a branch, worktree, or session. Starting a session requires the Task Launcher sidebar (session.create needs a user gesture).

repo.description: owner/name; omit to use the current project's GitHub origin

createBranch.description: When true, report the branch that would be created or switched to. Never creates a worktree.
